fullPassage: Any new or threatening situation may require us to make decisions and this requires information. So important is communication during a disaster that normal social barriers are often lowered. We will talk to strangers in a way we would never consider normally. Even relatively low grade disruption of our life such as a fire drill or a very late train seems to give us the permission to break normal etiquette and talk to strangers. The more important an event to a particular public, the more detailed and urgent the requirement for news becomes. Without an authoritative source of facts, whether that is a newspaper or trusted broadcast station, rumours often run riot. Rumours start because people believe their group to be in danger and so, although the rumour is unproven, feel they should pass it on. For example, if a worker heard that their employer’s business was doing badly and people were going to be made redundant, they would pass that information on to colleagues. *redundant: (일시) 해고된

"사람들은 자기 집단이 위험에 처해 있다고 믿는다."

[ be / believe / danger / group / in / people / their / to ] (8단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 정답: people believe their group to be in danger — believe + 목적어 + to be
det.analysis:
우리말 '사람들은 자기 집단이 위험에 처해 있다고 믿는다'에 맞게 배열하는 문제예요.

① 주어: '사람들은' = people.

② 동사: '믿는다' = believe.

③ believe는 '목적어 + to be' 구조를 데려와요. '자기 집단이' = their group, '~에 처해 있다고' = to be in danger.

④ 이으면 believe their group to be in danger.

⑤ 전부 합치면 people believe their group to be in danger (8단어).
det.tip: believe + 목적어(their group) + to be + 상태(in danger) = ~가 …라고 믿다.

accept: people believe their group to be in danger

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]의 단어를 모두 사용하여 영어로 문장을 완성하시오. (7단어)

우리말: 사람들은 해고될 예정이었다.

[조건] (1) be, going, made, people, redundant, to, were 를 모두 사용할 것 (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 정답: people were going to be made redundant — be going to(예정) + 수동태(be made)
det.analysis:
'~할 예정이었다'는 과거의 예정을 나타내는 were going to를 써요. 주어 people(복수)에 맞춰 were예요: people were going to.

'해고되다'는 스스로 하는 게 아니라 당하는 것이라 수동태 be made redundant(be동사 + 과거분사)로 써요. (redundant는 각주에서 '해고된'이라는 뜻이에요.)

'be going to' 뒤에는 동사원형이 오니 be made가 이어져요.

최종: people / were / going / to / be / made / redundant (7단어).
det.tip: be going to(예정) + be + 과거분사(made) = 해고될 예정이다. 주어 people → were.

questions.wa: people were going to be made redundant
accept: people were going to be made redundant
